description: This file contains helper functions for interacting with Tiingo API within the OpenBB platform. Specifically, it includes an asynchronous function get_data to fetch and process data from a URL endpoint, handling errors and exceptions related to JSON decoding and API authorization.

methods.name: Union[dict,list] get_data(url: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from a specified URL endpoint of Tiingo API, processes the JSON response, and handles potential errors such as JSON decoding issues or authorization errors.
